why: A marketplace that says its cash scale, holding one market that says its scales and one that sends them as null (fm-server#1059). Without it cash is read as cents whatever the server says, and a null decimal count comes through as null or zero rather than the default.

source.constructed: fm-server does not send cashDecimals, priceDecimals or unitDecimals yet (fm-server#1060); this is the shape docs/PRICE-SCALE.md section 3.1 gives them, with cashDecimals = priceDecimals + unitDecimals for the first market.

payload.name: Fine
payload.description: prices to the hundredth of a cent
